verdict.rationale: Plausible publishes an official self-hosting guide for Plausible Community Edition, and independent users confirm they run it self-hosted, describing it as FOSS they could keep maintaining themselves. One community comment says setup is heavy because it needs ClickHouse; that is a complaint about effort, not a contradiction of the capability. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party self-hosting documentation in the pack (only a guide title), and evidence on feature parity between Community Edition and the hosted product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: A getting started guide to self-hosting Plausible Community Edition
I'm a very happy self-hosted Plausible user for years now. Solid, simple, and easy to maintain.
One huge selling point of using Plausible is that you can self-host it and it's FOSS.
